title: Doro Family Puppies — litters
description: Every litter and puppy on the site. Edit litters.json; this file lists what each field may hold.

litters.description: Newest first. The site shows every litter whose listed is true.

slug.patternErrorMessage: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only, e.g. bella or mr-pickles.

photo.description: A file in src/images/parents/, shown only as a small round icon on the litter card.

sex.description: Sets the pink or blue accent and paw.

status.description: What a visitor can do. The Ready (date) badge is never typed: it comes from the litter's readyDate.
enumDescriptions: Shows the Inquire button. Before the litter's readyDate the badge reads Ready and the date, e.g. Ready Jul 28.
Deposit paid. Amber badge; the page points to littermates still available.
Gone home. The page points to littermates still available, or the waitlist.
Brown. Breed clubs call it chocolate.

pattern.description: Joins the color on the page: White and black parti.
enumDescriptions: Mostly white with patches of a second color.
Solid, with a white chest, belly and feet.
Two colors, with tan or cream points on face, chest and legs.
Darker tips on lighter hair; often lightens with age.
Marbled patches of a diluted color.
Shows Vaccinated, the date and the note.

oz.description: Ounces as a number: 27.8, not "27.8 oz".

slug.description: Unique across all litters. Also the photo folder: src/images/(litter id)/(slug)/.

markings.description: A short phrase starting with a capital, e.g. Black spot on left eye.

personality.description: One to three words, e.g. Chill cuddler.

weights.description: Append one entry per weigh-in. The page shows the latest with the puppy's age.

cover.description: A file in this puppy's folder to show first. Default: the first file alphabetically.

defaultSnippets.label: New puppy
defaultSnippets.description: Then make the folder src/images/(litter id)/(slug)/

lineage.description: A DNA test that confirms the parents' lineage. Copy it into each new litter from the same mom and dad.

sourceUrl.patternErrorMessage: Start it with https://, e.g. https://www.wisdompanel.com.
sourceUrl.description: The test's main website. The footnote links the test's name to it, e.g. https://www.wisdompanel.com.

tested.description: The puppy who was tested, e.g. Bear.

testedFrom.description: Which litter, e.g. Coco & Leo's first litter.

photo.description: A file in src/images/parents/, shown as a small square beside the tested puppy's name.

breeds.description: Whole percentages that add up to 100.

id.description: Year-month-mom-dad, e.g. 2026-06-coco-leo. Never rename once photos exist: it is the folder name.

listed.description: false hides this litter from the site without deleting anything.

due.description: While expecting. The site shows Due (date) until born is set.

readyDate.description: Ready to go home. Until then, available puppies' badges read Ready and this date.

litterSize.description: Only if not every puppy is listed. Otherwise the puppies are counted.

facts.description: Key breed facts, one short sentence each.

cover.description: A file in src/images/(litter id)/ to lead Home's gallery. Default: the first file alphabetically.

defaultSnippets.label: New litter
defaultSnippets.description: An expecting litter. Add born, readyDate and puppies when they arrive.
